answer: A clone army only pays if new identities earn instantly. Pay for continuity instead: rewards vest only to identities that answer in consecutive epochs, like a zephyr that gains force as it crosses an orchard season after season - each unbroken streak raises the payout multiplier, while a fresh clone starts at zero. Split effort across ten clones and every streak stays thin. The ledger keeps each streak at the wharf where work is checked in, so buying a ready-made identity buys nothing: the streak, not the name, is what pays.
